title: Playboy November 1980 Women of the US Government Hagman Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Vintage 1980 issue. Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge wear and small chips at the top corner of the spine. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
description:
Playboy magazine, November 1980 - Election Special issue, original $2.50 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: The Women of the U.S. Government - ten-page pictorial; How Washington Really Works: a primer for Jimmy, Ron or John; Larry Hagman interview (Who Cares Who Shot J.R.?); Playing With Pain: Life in the N.F.L.

Back cover: Carlton cigarettes ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
